name: Trezor C2 Full Confirmation (headless @trezor/connect in offscreen)
description: Loads the headless @trezor/connect SDK + injected BridgeTransport in the offscreen document and verifies getPublicKey({m/44'/60'/0'/0, eth}) returns the canonical SLIP-14 xpub against the real trezor-user-env bridge. This is the production C2 mechanism in miniature.
